```{r}
school_names = c(
  "broncosports"    = "Boise State",
  "csurams"         = "Colorado State",
  "gobulldogs"      = "Fresno State",
  "osubeavers"      = "Oregon State",
  "utahstateaggies" = "Utah State",
  "goaztecs"        = "San Diego State",
  "wsucougars"      = "Washington State",
  "txst"            = "Texas State"
)

urls = c(
  "https://broncosports.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://csurams.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://gobulldogs.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://osubeavers.com/sports/football/roster"
)

roster_function = function(roster_url){
  webpage = rvest::read_html(roster_url)
  
  # Get player cards first
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".s-person-card") -> cards
  
  # Names
  cards |> rvest::html_element("h3") |> rvest::html_text2() -> names
  
  # Position
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(1)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> position
  position = stringr::str_remove(position, "Position ")
  
  # Year
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(2)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> year
  year = stringr::str_remove(year, "Academic Year ")
  
  # Height
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(3)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> height
  height = stringr::str_remove(height, "Height ")
  
  # Weight
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(4)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> weight
  weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, "Weight ")
  weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, " lbs")
  
  # Hometown
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-card__content__person__location-item") |> rvest::html_text2() -> hometown
  hometown = stringr::str_remove(hometown, "Hometown")
  split_home = stringr::str_split_fixed(hometown, ",", n = 2)
  city  = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 1])
  state = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 2])
  
  # Previous school
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-card__content__person__previous-school-item") |> rvest::html_text2() -> prev_school
  prev_school = stringr::str_squish(prev_school)
  prev_school = stringr::str_remove(prev_school, "^.*Previous School(\\(s\\))?:\\s*")
  
  # Current school
  site = stringr::str_extract(roster_url, "(?<=://)[^.]+")
  school = unname(school_names[site])
  
  # Make the data frame
  df = data.frame(school = school, name = names, year = year, position = position,
                  height = height, weight_lbs = weight,
                  hometown_city = city, hometown_state = state,
                  previous_school = prev_school)
  
  # Drop coach/staff cards (no listed position)
  df = df[!is.na(df$position), ]
  
  return(df)
}

pac_12_df = data.frame()
for (url in urls) {
  df = roster_function(roster_url = url)
  
  pac_12_df = rbind(pac_12_df, df)
  
  Sys.sleep(2)
}
```
```{r}
urls2 = c(
  "https://goaztecs.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://wsucougars.com/sports/football/roster"
)

roster_function2 = function(roster_url){
  webpage = rvest::read_html(roster_url)
  
  # Get player cards first
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".roster-list-item") -> cards
  
  # Names
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-list-item__title, .rosters-list-item__title-link") |> rvest::html_text2() -> names
  
   # Position
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--position, .roster-list-item__fields-item:nth-child(1) > :nth-child(1)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> position
  position = stringr::str_remove_all(position, "\\[|\\]")
  
  # Year
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--class-level, .roster-list-item__fields-item:nth-child(2) > :nth-child(1)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> year
  year = stringr::str_remove_all(year, "\\[|\\]")
  
  # Height
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--height > span, .roster-list-item__fields-item:nth-child(1) > :nth-child(2)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> height
  height = stringr::str_remove(height, "Height ")
  
  # Weight
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--weight, .roster-list-item__fields-item:nth-child(1) > :nth-child(3)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> weight
  weight = stringr::str_remove_all(weight, "\\[|\\]")
  weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, " lbs")
  
  # Hometown
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--hometown, .roster-list-item__fields-item:nth-child(2) > :nth-child(2)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> hometown
  hometown = stringr::str_remove(hometown, "Hometown")
  hometown = stringr::str_remove_all(hometown, "\\[|\\]")
  split_home = stringr::str_split_fixed(hometown, ",", n = 2)
  city  = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 1])
  state = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 2])
  
  # Previous school (NA for players who didn't transfer)
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--previous-school, .roster-list-item__fields-item:nth-child(2) > :nth-child(4)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> prev_school
  prev_school = stringr::str_remove_all(prev_school, "\\[|\\]")
  
  # Current school
  site = stringr::str_extract(roster_url, "(?<=://)[^.]+")
  school = unname(school_names[site])
  
  # Make the data frame
  df = data.frame(school = school, name = names, year = year, position = position,
                  height = height, weight_lbs = weight,
                  hometown_city = city, hometown_state = state,
                  previous_school = prev_school)
  
  # Drop coach/staff cards (no listed position)
  df = df[!is.na(df$position), ]
  
  return(df)
}

for (url in urls2) {
  df = roster_function2(roster_url = url)
  
  pac_12_df = rbind(pac_12_df, df)
  
  Sys.sleep(2)
}
```
```{r}
urls3 = c(
  "https://txst.com/sports/football/roster"
)

roster_function3 = function(roster_url){
  webpage = rvest::read_html(roster_url)
  
  # Get player cards first
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".sidearm-roster-player") -> cards
  
   # Names
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".sidearm-roster-player-name h3") |> rvest::html_text2() -> names
  names = stringr::str_squish(names)
  
  # Position
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".sidearm-roster-player-position .text-bold") |> rvest::html_text2() -> position
  position = stringr::str_squish(position)
    position = stringr::str_remove(position, "\\s+\\S+$")
  
  # Year
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".sidearm-roster-player-custom1") |> rvest::html_text2() -> year
  year = stringr::str_squish(year)
  
  # Height
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".sidearm-roster-player-height") |> rvest::html_text2() -> height
  
  # Weight
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".sidearm-roster-player-weight") |> rvest::html_text2() -> weight
  weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, " lbs")
  
  # Hometown
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".sidearm-roster-player-hometown") |> rvest::html_text2() -> hometown
  split_home = stringr::str_split_fixed(hometown, ",", n = 2)
  city  = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 1])
  state = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 2])
  
  # Previous school
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".sidearm-roster-player-previous-school") |> rvest::html_text2() -> prev_school
  prev_school = stringr::str_squish(prev_school)
  
  # Current school
  site = stringr::str_extract(roster_url, "(?<=://)[^.]+")
  school = unname(school_names[site])
  
  # Make the data frame
  df = data.frame(school = school, name = names, year = year, position = position,
                  height = height, weight_lbs = weight,
                  hometown_city = city, hometown_state = state,
                  previous_school = prev_school)
  
  df = df[!is.na(df$position), ]
  
  return(df)
}

for (url in urls3) {
  df = roster_function3(roster_url = url)
  
  pac_12_df = rbind(pac_12_df, df)
  
  Sys.sleep(2)
}

table(pac_12_df$school)
```
